annual_rollover.calibration: for each cutoff 2..17 rerun same global train-only ratio across pseudo-current seasons 2022..Y-1; no family search
annual_rollover.materiality: carry prior fallback bound and take max with newly available all-pop position historical maximum at cutoff 0..17
annual_rollover.mode: deterministic annual refresh plus minimal governed freeze
annual_rollover.on_gate_or_source_failure: no automatic point authority; explicit omission + materiality gate where supported; otherwise fail closed
annual_rollover.player_role_priors: recompute cumulative prior player opportunity/game sufficient statistics through Y-1
annual_rollover.position_rates: recompute cumulative exact lost-fumble/opportunity and opportunity/game rates through Y-1
annual_rollover.target_year_Y_inputs: completed governed exact weekly seasons through Y-1 only
annual_rollover.uncertainty: for each position/cutoff c, new_floor=max(prior_floor[p,c], max newly completed held-out residual RMSE[p,k] for every k<=c); preserves monotone prefix floor

fallback_bound.formula: max(position-wide historical maximum season-equivalent target from all completed prior seasons, previously frozen rolling primary-population bound when cutoff>=2)
fallback_bound.identity_light: eligible only when canonical offensive position is known/non-conflicting and the matching position/cutoff cold-start population is eligible; uses tier-agnostic position bound
fallback_bound.restriction: QB cold-start and identity-light fail closed at cutoffs 13-17; all other observed tiers/cutoffs remain eligible subject to the runtime materiality inequality

season_start.week0: no first-party point estimate; explicit omission; NON_MATERIAL_PARTIAL only if frozen bound test passes
season_start.week1: no first-party point estimate; explicit omission; NON_MATERIAL_PARTIAL only if frozen bound test passes
season_start.week2_transition: enter already-supported Week-2 rolling model; if unavailable, use corrected fallback gate
